The Horizon
AI threat intelligence dashboard — prototype access

Hi all,

The AI Team has built The Horizon, a prototype dashboard that continuously monitors the open-source AI threat landscape — ingesting research papers, government advisories, and security industry feeds — and synthesises them into structured intelligence you can act on. Below is a quick overview of what you can do with it.

Request access

Reach out to [name] at [email] to request an account. Login details and a short user guide will be sent on registration. Please contact us using your CSA email address for account-related requests.

This is an early prototype — feedback on your experience is welcome and will feed into future development.

Note: The Horizon is currently hosted on Vercel and must be accessed from a personal device — it is not accessible from a COMET laptop. Cloud hosting (e.g. AWS) is planned for a future iteration.

Core Functions
Threat Dashboard
Ask Agent

Stay across AI threats week-by-week, month-by-month, and quarter-by-quarter. The dashboard synthesises intelligence across four threat categories — each with trend signals, maturity assessments, and cited sources you can drill into — so you always know what's emerging and what's escalating.

Query the platform's entire corpus in plain language — "What prompt injection attacks have been reported this month?" — and get a cited answer in seconds. Useful for quick research, briefing prep, or tracking a specific threat over time.
Briefing Decks
Newsletter

Need to brief leadership or a wider team? The platform auto-generates a PowerPoint deck — threat summaries, source-grounded findings, and trend analysis — that you can present directly or adapt for your audience.

A curated digest generated each week and month, summarising key developments with links to the sources. Copy and paste it directly into Gmail or Outlook to share with your team.
